meta.name: My ID Is Gangnam Beauty
meta.description: Bullied for her looks, Mi-rae gets plastic surgery hoping for a better kind of life but faces new challenges in college. Based on a hit Korean webtoon.

videos.title: I'm Pretty Starting from Today
videos.overview: Tormented for her looks throughout most of her life, Kang Mi-rae makes a big decision to make sure that college will be different.

videos.title: You Should've Been Pretty from the Get-go
videos.overview: Mi-rae shows her new face to her father. At school, she attracts the attention of students including Do Kyeong-seok, who knows about her past.

videos.title: You Don’t Even Know
videos.overview: A bully brings out Mi-rae's insecurities, while rumors of her past connection to Kyeong-seok start to spread around school.

videos.title: You’ve Grown Up So Much
videos.overview: Kyeong-seok feels conflicted about the CEO of a perfume company, who becomes a new role model for Mi-rae.

videos.title: The Handsome Guy’s Counterattack
videos.overview: Mi-rae has a heart-to-heart chat with Kyeong-seok, while plans for the college festival make her uneasy when she sees the outfit she's supposed to wear.

videos.title: The Handsome Guy’s Counterattack Part 2
videos.overview: Mi-rae runs into an old classmate at the festival and notices that there's something odd about Hyeon Su-a.

videos.title: A Guy Friend
videos.overview: The campus is abuzz with gossip about his privileged background, as Kyeong-seok arrives at an ugly truth about his broken family.

videos.title: Basic Instinct
videos.overview: Mi-rae and Kyeong-seok go to the movies and have dinner together. Kyeong-seok goes in search for new lodging.

videos.title: The Survival Story of a 20-Year-Old
videos.overview: The newly independent Kyeong-seok looks for a job, starts over with his mother, and decides to be honest about his feelings for Mi-rae.

videos.title: I Can Be Your Boyfriend
videos.overview: Kyeong-seok and Yeon U-yeong compete for Mi-rae's affections. Mi-rae deals with her low self-confidence when Su-a reveals her true colors.

videos.title: Your ID is Gangnam Beauty
videos.overview: Believing she's not good enough for Kyeong-seok, Mi-rae tries to distance herself but can't avoid him when they start a part-time job at the same place.

videos.title: Don't You Have Feelings for Me?
videos.overview: Mi-rae says she only thinks of him as a friend, but Kyeong-seok doesn't give up. An unexpected talk with U-yeong puts Mi-rae in a bind.

videos.title: It’s My First Love
videos.overview: Mi-rae starts to see herself in a new light after she gets a worrying glimpse of Su-a -- and also makes a decision about Kyeong-seok.

videos.title: Start Secretly
videos.overview: Trying to date in secret proves to be a challenge for Mi-rae and Kyeong-seok. Su-a is perturbed by photos of her circulating online.

videos.title: My Boyfriend is Do Kyeong-seok
videos.overview: Su-a confronts the wrong person about the photos. Mi-rae and Kyeong-seok decide to tell their classmates about their relationship.

videos.title: Even Though We Don't Know Much About Life Yet
videos.overview: Su-a escapes a bad situation with Mi-rae's help and decides to make some changes. Mi-rae plans a surprise for Kyeong-seok's birthday.

meta.slogan: A beauty who feels unfamiliar with her beauty.
